meta.notes: Legal entity is a nadační fond (family foundation) with its own capital, investing directly in companies (family_office type); registry number taken from the investor's own imprint, not confirmed in the registry. Stages: site also says it backs early-stage firms ('začínající podniky') without a clear stage label, so only growth mapped. Hint's Carebot deal not confirmed: a Forbes.cz report on Carebot's 2026 round names Garage Angels, Electron Capital, JIC Ventures, Gain Ventures, not Dendis Capital; only third-party trackers (not used) list Dendis in Carebot Sep 2025. Instrument for HTG not stated in source (equity assumed from 'kolo'); Dendis described as existing investor, so role participant. No ticket or AUM published.
